quoteSection.title: Line-by-Line Quotations
paragraphs: Already know what you need? A quotation request is the fastest route. Share the product names, sizes or catalog references, your specifications or preferred brands, the quantities, and the delivery location. If the purchase is part of a tender, include the reference.
You will receive a line-by-line quotation with product details, prices, lead times and the documents for each item. It is ready for your team to review and compare.

listSection.title: Equipment and Product Lists
paragraphs: For larger requirements, such as equipping a new ward or facility, upload your equipment list as a PDF, Word or Excel file. Photos, reference documents and specification sheets help us get it right the first time.

Don't have every detail yet? Send what you have, along with your timeline and delivery location, and we will help you fill in the gaps. If you are unsure which product fits your need, simply describe how it will be used.

assistSection.title: The Right Route for Every Inquiry
paragraphs: Hospitals and procurement teams can use the quotation or requirement forms. Doctors and hospital pharmacies looking for a specialty medicine for a specific patient can use our specialty medicine form. It asks only for the details that process needs.

Manufacturers, suppliers, distributors and logistics providers can reach us through the Supplier and Partnership Inquiry. Share your company profile, the products or services you offer, your available documents and the markets you serve.

whatHappens.title: What Happens After You Reach Out
paragraphs: We review your requirement and any files you send, and contact you if anything needs clarifying. We then check sourcing options and documents with our suppliers and send you a quotation with quantities, prices, lead times and supporting documents.
There is no obligation until you approve the quotation. Timelines and documents vary by product and destination, and we will tell you clearly what to expect at each step.

closing.title: Prefer to Talk First?
closing.text: Every good supply relationship starts with one clear conversation. Call, email or message us, and we will help you find the best way forward.
